title: Zoning text change for 200 Kent Avenue, Brooklyn
summary: This resolution approves, with modifications, a zoning text amendment establishing a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 200 Kent Avenue in Williamsburg, Brooklyn. It relates to a companion zoning map change that would allow converting and expanding a five-story commercial building into a 14-story mixed-use project with 143 residential units, of which about 29 to 43 would be income-restricted. The Council held a public hearing on the proposal on July 21, 2026.
